description: This Java class defines the exception AclNotAccessibleException used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It indicates that the access control list of a Thing cannot be accessed, either because the Thing was not found or the authorization subject has insufficient permissions. The class includes methods for constructing instances from messages and JSON objects, as well as a builder for customization.

classes.name: AclNotAccessibleException
classes.description: An exception indicating that the ACL of a Thing cannot be accessed by a particular Authorization Subject because it was not found or permissions are insufficient.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder to construct an AclNotAccessibleException with specific ThingId and AuthorizationSubject.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a specified message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object representing the error.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
